e.title: **一个**用 Go 写的智利年金准备金引擎**，**并**把「**误差住在哪一段**」**列成表**：`fcaStockhausen/reservin`——**⭐ 逐字（西语）**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**逐档给出**与监管报送的差异**：**独有被扶养人 **+0.2%**、**有配偶 **+0.4%**、**有子女 **−1.5%**、**无在世被扶养人 **+21.8%**、**整体 **+3.3%****，**并**按年代分层**（**2012 年后 **−1.1%**、**2005–2011 **+17.2%**、**2005 年前 **+14.1%**）**；**⭐ 并**逐字说明**「**引擎是为**现代保单校准的**，**残差集中在**2020 年前**且**没有历史 **VTD 的存量上**」**；**⚠️ 而**它**自己定的规矩里**禁止提交 **`.DS_Store`**，**而仓库里**正好**有一个****
e.title_en: A Go engine for Chilean annuity technical reserves that tabulates where its own error lives: it reports differences against the regulatory filing for each family type, from a fraction of a percent for most cases to over twenty percent where no beneficiary survives, gives the same breakdown by policy vintage, states that the engine is calibrated for modern policies with the residual gap concentrated in pre-2020 stock that lacks historical discount curves, and forbids committing a macOS metadata file that its own repository contains.
e.title_hk: **一個**用 Go 寫的智利年金準備金引擎**，**並**把「**誤差住在哪一段**」**列成表**：`fcaStockhausen/reservin`——**⭐ 逐字（西語）**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 而**它**逐檔給出**與監管報送的差異**：**獨有被扶養人 +0.2%**、**有配偶 +0.4%**、**有子女 −1.5%**、**無在世被扶養人 +21.8%**、**整體 +3.3%****，**並**按年代分層**（**2012 年後 −1.1%**、**2005–2011 +17.2%**、**2005 年前 +14.1%**）**；**⭐ 並**逐字說明**「**引擎是為現代保單校準的**，**殘差集中在 2020 年前**且**沒有歷史 VTD 的存量上**」**；**⚠️ 而**它**自己定的規矩禁止提交 `.DS_Store`**，**而倉庫裡正好有一個****
e.summary: **Reservín**（仓库 `fcaStockhausen/reservin`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**智利年金准备金引擎****——**逐字自述（西语）为**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**，**并**逐字注明它**遵循 **CMF 的 **NCG 318、**Circular 2332、**Circular 1512** 与 **SPensiones 的 **Nota Técnica N°9**，**且**与各公司报送给 **CMF 的 **RIS 文件（**Circular 1194**）**做校验****。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**语言 **Go**（**README 逐字写明 **Go 1.25**）**、**创建 **2026-08-07**、**最后推送 **2026-08-09**、**★1**、**仓库约 **20.7 MB****、**共 **106 个文件／**5 个 Go 测试文件****；**⭐ 其性能自述为**并行约 **每秒 **1,350 张保单**，**并**在**约 **10 分钟**内**校验完整的 **RIS（**95.9 万张保单**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 它**把**误差**按**家庭结构与**年代**逐档列出**（**含 **+21.8% 与 **+17.2% 两个**明显偏大的档**）**；**② **⭐ 并**逐字说明**偏差**住在哪里**（**2020 年前**且**无历史 **VTD 的存量**）；**③ **⭐ 它**带一个**不依赖数据库的 **RIS 规范读取器**（**可**逐张解码、**列代码字典、**扫描出现过的代码**）**；**④ **⭐ 而**其 **`AGENTS.md`（**9,850 字节**）**把**给 AI 代理的规矩**写得**比许多**人读文档还细**（**⭐ 含**「**没读进度文档前**不许动引擎**」**与**「**未经用户明确要求**不许提交**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未编译、**未运行**。
e.summary_hk: **Reservín**（倉庫 `fcaStockhausen/reservin`）**是一個**用 Go 寫的**智利年金準備金引擎****——**逐字自述（西語）為**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**，**並**逐字註明它**遵循 CMF 的 NCG 318、**Circular 2332、**Circular 1512** 與 SPensiones 的 Nota Técnica N°9**，**且**與各公司報送給 CMF 的 RIS 檔案（**Circular 1194**）**做校驗****。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**語言 Go**（**README 逐字寫明 Go 1.25**）**、**創建 2026-08-07**、**最後推送 2026-08-09**、**★1**、**倉庫約 20.7 MB****、**共 106 個檔案／**5 個 Go 測試檔案****；**⭐ 性能自述為**並行約每秒 1,350 張保單**，**並**在約 10 分鐘內**校驗完整 RIS（**95.9 萬張保單**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一種語言的同題材實現，**以及**倉庫裡那份給 AI 代理的檔案**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 它把誤差按**家庭結構與年代**逐檔列出**（**含 +21.8% 與 +17.2% 兩個明顯偏大的檔**）**；**② **⭐ 並逐字說明偏差住在哪裡**；**③ **⭐ 它帶一個**不依賴數據庫的 RIS 規範讀取器**；**④ **⭐ 而其 `AGENTS.md`（**9,850 位元組**）**把給 AI 代理的規矩**寫得**比許多人讀文檔還細**。**⚠️ 本次**未編譯、**未運行**。
e.summary_en: This repository **is a Go engine for computing technical reserves on Chilean annuity policies**, described verbatim in Spanish as an actuarial engine for the technical reserves of life annuity policies in the Chilean system, stating that it follows several regulator circulars together with a supervisory technical note and that it is validated against the regulatory filing that insurers submit. **Measured this round**: MIT licensed, written in Go with the version stated in the readme, created in early August and last pushed two days later, one star, a repository of about twenty megabytes, a hundred and six files and five Go test files, with the readme claiming roughly one thousand three hundred and fifty policies per second in parallel and a full regulatory file of just under a million policies validated in about ten minutes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.** **Four things are worth reading: it lists its own error by family structure and by policy vintage, including two groups that are off by more than seventeen percent; it states in words where the residual gap lives; it ships a canonical reader for the regulatory file that needs no database and can decode one policy, print the code dictionary and scan which codes actually occur; and its instruction file for AI agents is nearly ten kilobytes and lays down rules stricter than most human-facing documentation, including not touching the engine before reading the progress document and not committing anything unless the user explicitly asks.** **The engine was not compiled and not run this round.**
e.body:
**Reservín**（仓库 `fcaStockhausen/reservin`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**智利年金准备金引擎****——**逐字自述（西语）为**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**，**并**逐字注明它**遵循 **CMF 的 **NCG 318、**Circular 2332、**Circular 1512** 与 **SPensiones 的 **Nota Técnica N°9**，**且**与各公司报送给 **CMF 的 **RIS 文件（**Circular 1194**）**做校验**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。

**可核实信息（均仓库元数据与仓库内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把**误差**按家庭结构与年代**逐档列出****——**⭐ 校验对象逐字为**「**RIS 2025-12-31**」**，**样本 **50K、**实际处理 **44K**，**逐档差异为**：**「**causante solo**」** **+0.2%**、**「**con cónyuge**」** **+0.4%**、**「**con hijos**」** **−1.5%**、**「**cónyuge + hijos**」** **−0.1%**、**「**sin causante vivo**」** **+21.8%**、**「**Global**」** **+3.3%****；**并**另按年代分层**：**2012 年后 **−1.1%**、**2005–2011 **+17.2%**、**2005 年前 **+14.1%****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一张表**是本条最有价值的部分**：**⭐ 即**它**既报了**好看的两档（**+0.2%／**+0.4%**）**，**也**报了**难看的**两档（**+21.8%／**+17.2%**）**——**⭐ 而**很多项目**只会报**总量口径**（**这里就是那个 **+3.3%**）**，**从而**把**最能说明问题的**分层偏差**藏起来**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**逐字说明**偏差住在哪里，**并**给出**校准的适用范围****——**逐字为**「**El motor está calibrado para pólizas modernas (post-sep-2020 con VTD del mes de emisión: gap <1% por póliza). El gap residual se concentra en stock pre-2020 sin VTD histórico disponible**」**，**并**指向**一份专门的说明文件**（**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md`，**18,146 字节**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**它**没有**说「**模型准确**」**，**而**是说**「**为**2020 年 9 月后的**现代保单校准**；**每张保单的**偏差**小于 **1%**；**残差**集中在**2020 年前**且**没有历史 **VTD（**折现曲线）**的存量上**」**——**⭐ 把**「**我错在哪**」**说成**一句**可核对的话**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它带一个**不依赖数据库的 RIS 规范读取器****——**⭐ 本次实测**其命令逐字含** `-ris-dump <archivo> -svs 099747`（**逐张解码**）**、**`-filter dead -n 5`（**筛选已故被扶养人**）**、**`-json`（**逐行 JSON，**便于脚本处理**）**、**`-legend`（**逐字为 **C1194 的**代码字典**）**、**`-scan-codes`（**扫描文件中**出现过的代码**）**；**⭐ 并**另有**校验命令的**可选开关****：**`-retenida`（**对**自留准备金**比较**）**、**`-no-mejoramiento`（**不使用 **AAx 改善因子**，**用作敏感性**）**、**`-debug-svs <编号>`（**逐人明细**）**、**`-vtd-sens`（**对**折现曲线**做敏感性**）**；**⭐ 以及**组合生成、**压力测试与**YAML 情景**（**`-gen-ris`、**`-stress`、**`-scenario`**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组命令**说明**它**不是**一个**只算一个数的脚本**，**而**是一套**面向**监管报送**的**核对工具**：**⭐ 即**「**先把**对方的文件**读进来**（**含**字典与**代码扫描**）**，**再**逐档比**，**再**做**敏感性**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库里**有一份 **9,850 字节的 **`AGENTS.md`**，**而**它**给 AI 代理的规矩**比**许多**人读文档更细****——**⭐ 逐字含**：**开场**「**Guía para cualquier agente (humano o IA) que trabaje en este repo. Léela antes de tocar nada.**」**；**⭐ **「**Lee primero:** docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md**」**——**逐字續**「**No toques el motor sin haberlo leído.**」**；**⭐ **推送规则**（**逐字**「**Git push siempre a `origin main` (GitHub). El remote `server` (Tailscale) existe por compatibilidad pero NO se debe pushear ahí salvo orden explícita del usuario.**」**）**；**⭐ **不得提交清单**（**逐字含** `.DS_Store`、**除特定目录外的 **`*.xlsx`、**`cpu.prof`、**`data/*.vta` 等**）**；**⭐ **数据库规则**（**逐字**「**No commitear la DB `data/reservas.db` con datos personales o RIS crudo.**」**）**；**⭐ **语言规则**（**提交信息用英文**，**代码与注释**按**周围文件**决定**）**；**⭐ 以及两条**很少见**的规矩**：**逐字**「**No añadir comentarios explicativos salvo que el usuario lo pida. El código se explica solo.**」**与**「**No commitear nada sin que el usuario lo pida explícito.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后两条**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**这份文件**假定**读者**是一个**会**自作主张**的**代理**，**故**提前**把**「**不要多写注释**」**与**「**不要自己提交**」**写成**明文**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一处**规则与现状不一致（如实记录）****——**⭐ `AGENTS.md` **逐字把 **`.DS_Store` 列入**不得提交**的清单**，**而**本次实测**该文件**确实存在于仓库的 **HEAD 树中****（**⭐ 即**规则写在文档里**，**而**仓库里**恰好**有一个**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**这一点**，**并**注明**其影响很小**（**⭐ 只是一个 **macOS 元数据文件**）**——**⭐ 但**它**正好**是**「**文档里的规矩**」**与**「**仓库里的现状**」**不一致的**一个可核查样本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 体量与结构（可核对）**：**仓库 **106 个文件／**约 **20.7 MB****、**⭐ **5 个 Go 测试文件**（**逐字含 **`ris1194_test.go`、**`ris_case_test.go`、**`pg_test.go`、**`tabla_test.go`、**`generator_test.go`**）**；**⭐ 目录按文件数**含 **`docs/normativo`（**28**，**监管 **PDF**）**、**`internal/models`（**12**）**、**`internal/database`（**9**）**、**`internal/calculator`（**7**）**、**`docs/analysis`（**5**）**、**`internal/loader`（**5**）**、**`cmd/calculator`（**4**）**、**`internal/scenario`（**4**）**、**`internal/portfolio`（**3**）**、**`data/normativo`（**2**）**；**⭐ 文档**含 **`AGENTS.md` **9,850**、**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md` **18,146**、**`docs/analysis/validacion_ris_1194.md` **8,057**、**`docs/mortality_tables_guide.md` **6,923**、**`docs/analysis/reserve_calculation_guide.md` **6,015**、**`docs/analysis/mathematical_formulas.md` **5,262**、**`docs/analysis/formulas_cnu_nt9.md` **4,120**、**`descripcion.md` **1,261****；**⭐ 代码里还有**一个**抓取监管折现曲线的脚本**（**`scripts/scrape_vtd_cmf.py`**）**；**⭐ 依赖逐字含** `github.com/shopspring/decimal`（**逐字注明为 **UF 的**精确算术**）**、**`github.com/xuri/excelize/v2`（**读 **CMF 的 **xlsx 表**）**与 **`github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3`（**需要 **CGO**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**用 **decimal** 做 **UF（**智利通胀指数化记账单位**）的精确算术**」**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**通胀指数化**的负债上**，**浮点误差**不是**小问题**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[heavylight]] 覆盖**带准备金方法的**现金流库**、**[[lifecontingencies]] 与**[[pylifecontingencies]] 覆盖**生命或然**数学**、**[[colombian-pension-observatory]] 与**[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 覆盖**拉美与西语的**养老金主题**、**[[pension-pro-mcp]] 覆盖**养老金数据接口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**在**智利 **CMF 的监管口径下**、**用 **Go 实现并**与监管报送逐档对账的**年金准备金引擎**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **误差要**分层报**，**并**把**最难看的**那几档**留在表里**；**② **要说明**模型**为**哪一段**校准**、**残差**住在**哪一段**；**③ **对手方的文件**要先有**规范的读取器**（**含**代码字典与**代码扫描**）**；**④ **给 AI 代理**的规矩**要**写明**边界**（**不许动什么、**不许提交什么**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有编译、**没有运行**该引擎**（**未计算任何准备金、**未做任何 **RIS 校验**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何差异数字**、**不主张**其**结果符合 **CMF 的任何要求**、**也不主张**其**在**任何其他市场**适用**。**② ⚠️ **`AGENTS.md` 本次**只读了**开头若干段**（**⭐ 全文 **9,850 字节**，**本次读到**项目定义、**推送与**提交规则、**语言规则**等**）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**监管 **PDF 与**原始 **xlsx** 的来源与**再分发许可**（**⭐ 仓库里**含 **28 个 **`docs/normativo` 文件与 **2 个 **`data/normativo` 文件**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**生命表与 **VTD 数据**的**授权情况**（**⭐ 只知**仓库内**含一份 **SQLite 数据库**，**并**逐字说明**不得**把**含个人信息或**原始 **RIS 的版本**提交**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **README 的校验表**是**在哪一次运行**上得到的**（**⭐ 只知**标注为 **RIS 2025-12-31**、**样本 **50K**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**作者身份**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**仓库名与**其自述**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该仓库**创建于 **2026-08-07**、**最后推送 **2026-08-09**（**均在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**在**监管口径下**用 **Go 实现、**并**与监管报送**逐档对账的**年金准备金引擎**，**且**自带**不依赖数据库的**对手方文件读取器**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该引擎**是**开源实现**，**不是**任何**监管认可的计算工具**，**其**输出**与**报送要求**是否一致**须**由**使用者与**监管口径**自行确认**。

**Reservín**（倉庫 `fcaStockhausen/reservin`）**是一個**用 Go 寫的**智利年金準備金引擎****——**逐字自述（西語）為**「**Motor actuarial en Go para calcular reservas técnicas (VPPj) de pólizas de renta vitalicia del sistema chileno.**」**，**並**逐字註明它**遵循 CMF 的 NCG 318、**Circular 2332、**Circular 1512** 與 SPensiones 的 Nota Técnica N°9**，**且**與各公司報送給 CMF 的 RIS 檔案（**Circular 1194**）**做校驗****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一種語言的同題材實現，**以及**倉庫裡那份給 AI 代理的檔案**」**。

**可核實資訊（均倉庫元資料與倉庫內檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把誤差按家庭結構與年代逐檔列出****——**⭐ 校驗對象逐字為**「**RIS 2025-12-31**」**，**樣本 50K、**實際處理 44K**，**逐檔差異**：**causante solo +0.2%**、**con cónyuge +0.4%**、**con hijos −1.5%**、**cónyuge + hijos −0.1%**、**sin causante vivo +21.8%**、**Global +3.3%****；**並**按年代分層**：**2012 年後 −1.1%、**2005–2011 +17.2%、**2005 年前 +14.1%****。**⭐ 這一張表是最有價值的一處**：**⭐ 即**它既報了**好看的兩檔**，**也報了**難看的兩檔**——**⭐ 而**很多項目只報**總量口徑**（**這裡就是那個 +3.3%**）**，**把**最能說明問題的分層偏差**藏起來**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明偏差住在哪裡，**並給出**校準的適用範圍****——**逐字為**「**El motor está calibrado para pólizas modernas (post-sep-2020 con VTD del mes de emisión: gap <1% por póliza). El gap residual se concentra en stock pre-2020 sin VTD histórico disponible**」**，**並**指向一份專門說明檔**（**`docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md`，**18,146 位元組**）**。**⭐ 它沒有說「**模型準確**」**，**而是說**「**為 2020 年 9 月後的現代保單校準；**每張保單偏差小於 1%；**殘差集中在 2020 年前且沒有歷史 VTD 的存量上**」**——**⭐ 把「**我錯在哪**」說成一句可核對的話**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它帶一個不依賴數據庫的 RIS 規範讀取器****——**⭐ 命令逐字含 `-ris-dump <archivo> -svs 099747`、**`-filter dead -n 5`、**`-json`、**`-legend`（**逐字為 C1194 的代碼字典**）、**`-scan-codes`****；**⭐ 並有**校驗命令的可選開關**：**`-retenida`、**`-no-mejoramiento`、**`-debug-svs <編號>`、**`-vtd-sens`****；**⭐ 以及**組合生成、**壓力測試與 YAML 情景**（**`-gen-ris`、**`-stress`、**`-scenario`**）**。**⭐ 這說明它不是**只算一個數的腳本**，**而是一套**面向監管報送的核對工具**：**⭐ 即**「**先把對方檔案讀進來（**含字典與**代碼掃描）**，**再逐檔比**，**再做敏感性**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫裡有一份 9,850 位元組的 `AGENTS.md`**，**其規矩比許多人讀文檔更細****——**逐字含**開場**「**Guía para cualquier agente (humano o IA) que trabaje en este repo. Léela antes de tocar nada.**」**；**「**Lee primero:** docs/analysis/observaciones_avance.md**」**——**逐字續**「**No toques el motor sin haberlo leído.**」**；**推送規則**（**逐字**「**Git push siempre a `origin main` (GitHub). El remote `server` (Tailscale) existe por compatibilidad pero NO se debe pushear ahí salvo orden explícita del usuario.**」**）**；**不得提交清單**（**含 `.DS_Store`、**除特定目錄外的 `*.xlsx`、**`cpu.prof`、**`data/*.vta`**）**；**數據庫規則**（**逐字**「**No commitear la DB `data/reservas.db` con datos personales o RIS crudo.**」**）**；**語言規則**；**以及兩條很少見的規矩**：**逐字**「**No añadir comentarios explicativos salvo que el usuario lo pida. El código se explica solo.**」**與**「**No commitear nada sin que el usuario lo pida explícito.**」**。**⭐ 最後兩條最值得記**：**⭐ 即**這份文件**假定讀者是一個會自作主張的代理**，**故提前把「**不要多寫註釋**」與「**不要自己提交**」寫成明文**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一處規則與現狀不一致**——**`AGENTS.md` 逐字把 `.DS_Store` 列入不得提交清單**，**而本次實測該檔案確實存在於倉庫 HEAD 樹中****——**⭐ 本詞條**如實指出**，**並註明影響很小**（**只是一個 macOS 元資料檔**）**，**但**它是一個**可核查的樣本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 體量與結構**：**106 個檔案／**約 20.7 MB****、**5 個 Go 測試檔案**（**`ris1194_test.go`、**`ris_case_test.go`、**`pg_test.go`、**`tabla_test.go`、**`generator_test.go`**）**；**目錄**含 `docs/normativo`（**28，**監管 PDF**）、**`internal/models`（**12**）、**`internal/database`（**9**）、**`internal/calculator`（**7**）、**`docs/analysis`（**5**）、**`internal/loader`（**5**）、**`cmd/calculator`（**4**）、**`internal/scenario`（**4**）、**`internal/portfolio`（**3**）、**`data/normativo`（**2**）**；**文件**含 AGENTS.md 9,850、**observaciones_avance.md 18,146、**validacion_ris_1194.md 8,057、**mortality_tables_guide.md 6,923、**reserve_calculation_guide.md 6,015、**mathematical_formulas.md 5,262、**formulas_cnu_nt9.md 4,120、**descripcion.md 1,261****；**代碼裡還有一個**抓取監管折現曲線的腳本**（**`scripts/scrape_vtd_cmf.py`**）**；**依賴**含 `github.com/shopspring/decimal`（**逐字註明為 UF 的精確算術**）、**`github.com/xuri/excelize/v2`、**`github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3`（**需要 CGO**）**。**⭐ 「**用 decimal 做 UF 的精確算術**」值得記**：**⭐ 即**在**通脹指數化的負債上**，**浮點誤差不是小問題**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[heavylight]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[pylifecontingencies]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]、[[pension-pro-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**在智利 CMF 監管口徑下、**用 Go 實現並**與監管報送逐檔對賬的年金準備金引擎**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **誤差要分層報**，**並**把最難看的幾檔**留在表裡**；**② **要說明模型**為哪一段校準、**殘差住在哪一段**；**③ **對手方檔案**要有**規範讀取器**（**含代碼字典與**掃描**）**；**④ **給 AI 代理的規矩**要寫明邊界**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有編譯、**沒有運行**該引擎**，**不主張**其任何差異數字、**不主張**其結果符合 CMF 的任何要求、**也不主張**其在任何其他市場適用**。**② ⚠️ `AGENTS.md` 只讀了開頭若干段**（**全文 9,850 位元組**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其監管 PDF 與原始 xlsx 的來源與再分發許可**（**倉庫含 28 個 `docs/normativo` 檔案與 2 個 `data/normativo` 檔案**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其生命表與 VTD 數據的授權情況**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其 README 校驗表是在哪一次運行上得到的**（**只知**標註為 RIS 2025-12-31、**樣本 50K**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**創建於 2026-08-07、**最後推送 2026-08-09（**均在窗口之外**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**在監管口徑下用 Go 實現、**並與監管報送逐檔對賬的年金準備金引擎**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該引擎是開源實現**，**不是**任何監管認可的計算工具**。
e.body_en:
This repository **is a Go engine for computing technical reserves on Chilean annuity policies**, described verbatim in Spanish as an actuarial engine for the technical reserves of life annuity policies in the Chilean system, stating that it follows several regulator circulars together with a supervisory technical note and that it is validated against the regulatory filing insurers submit. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.**

**Verified information, all measured from repository metadata and the files inside the repository**: **first, it lists its own error by family structure and by policy vintage.** The validation is against a stated regulatory cut-off date, over a sample of fifty thousand records of which forty-four thousand were processed, and the reported differences are a fifth of a percent for a deceased member with no survivor, four tenths of a percent where a spouse survives, **minus one and a half percent where children survive**, minus a tenth of a percent where both survive, **plus twenty-one point eight percent where no member survives at all**, and **plus three point three percent overall**; by vintage the differences are minus one point one percent after 2012, **plus seventeen point two percent from 2005 to 2011**, and **plus fourteen point one percent before 2005**. **That table is the most valuable part of this entry: it reports both the flattering groups and the unflattering ones, whereas a project reporting only the overall figure would hide exactly the segmentation that explains the problem.** **Second, it states in words where the residual gap lives and for which population the engine is calibrated**, saying that the engine is calibrated for modern policies issued after September 2020 where the discount curve of the issue month is available and the per-policy gap is under one percent, and that the residual gap is concentrated in pre-2020 stock for which no historical discount curve exists, pointing to an eighteen-kilobyte progress document. **That is worth copying: rather than claiming accuracy, it says where it is calibrated, how large its per-policy error is there, and where the remaining error is concentrated.** **Third, it ships a canonical reader for the counterparty file that needs no database**, able to decode a single policy, filter to deceased members, emit line-delimited JSON for scripts, print the code dictionary for the filing standard, and scan which codes actually occur in a file. **The validation command also carries switches to compare against the retained rather than gross reserve, to disable the mortality improvement factors as a sensitivity, to print per-person detail for one identifier, and to run sensitivity across all loaded discount curves**, alongside portfolio generation, stress testing and YAML scenario runs. **That command set shows this is not a script computing one number but a reconciliation toolkit: read the counterparty file properly, compare group by group, then test sensitivity.** **Fourth, the repository carries an instruction file for AI agents of nearly ten kilobytes whose rules are stricter than much human-facing documentation.** It opens by telling any agent, human or artificial, to read it before touching anything; it names a progress document that must be read before modifying the engine; it specifies that pushes go to one remote while a second compatibility remote over a private network must not be pushed to without an explicit instruction from the user; it lists files that must never be committed, including a macOS metadata file, spreadsheet files outside specific directories, profiling output and raw regulatory extracts; it forbids committing the database when it contains personal data or raw regulatory material; it sets the language of commit messages; and **it contains two unusually strict rules, namely that explanatory comments must not be added unless the user asks and that nothing may be committed unless the user explicitly requests it**. **Those last two matter because the file assumes its reader is an agent inclined to act on its own initiative, and so writes the prohibitions down in advance.** **Fifth, one rule contradicts the repository state and is recorded plainly**: the same instruction file forbids committing a macOS metadata file, and such a file is present in the repository tree, a minor matter in itself but a checkable example of documentation diverging from the repository. **Sixth, size and structure are checkable**: a hundred and six files of about twenty megabytes with five Go test files including dedicated tests for the regulatory file format, and directories covering twenty-eight regulatory documents in PDF, a dozen model types, database repositories, the calculator engine, progress analysis documents, loaders, the portfolio generator, scenario simulation and configuration, plus documentation files ranging from a nine-kilobyte agent guide and an eighteen-kilobyte progress note to guides on mortality tables, reserve calculation, mathematical formulas and the specific formulas of the supervisory note, and a script that scrapes the regulator discount curves. **Dependencies include a decimal arithmetic library, explicitly noted as being for exact arithmetic in the Chilean inflation-indexed unit of account, a spreadsheet reader for the regulator tables, and a SQLite driver requiring CGO.** **Using exact decimal arithmetic for an inflation-indexed liability is worth recording, because floating point error is not a small matter there.** **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a cash flow library with reserve methods, life contingency mathematics in two languages, Latin American and Spanish pension projects and a pension data interface, **while this entry supplies an annuity reserve engine implemented in Go under one supervisor regulatory framework and reconciled group by group against the regulatory filing, with a database-free reader for the counterparty file. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: report error by segment and keep the worst segments in the table; say which population the model is calibrated for and where the residual error lives; build a canonical reader for the counterparty file, including its code dictionary and code scan; and state the boundaries in any instruction file meant for AI agents.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the engine was not compiled and not run**, so no reserve was computed and no filing was validated, **and no claim is made about any difference figure, about conformance to any requirement of the supervisor, or about applicability in any other market**. **Second, the instruction file was read only at its opening sections**, the whole file being nearly ten kilobytes. **Third, the provenance and redistribution licensing of the regulatory PDFs and original spreadsheets were not verified**, the repository containing twenty-eight regulatory documents and two normative data files. **Fourth, the licensing of its mortality tables and discount curve data was not verified**, it being stated only that the database must not be committed with personal data or raw regulatory material. **Fifth, the run on which the readme validation table is based was not verified**, only that it is labelled with a specific regulatory cut-off date and a fifty-thousand-record sample. **Sixth, the author identity was not verified.** **Seventh, on the window: the repository was created in early August and last pushed two days later, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is an annuity reserve engine implemented in Go under one supervisor framework, reconciled group by group against the regulatory filing, and shipping a database-free reader for the counterparty file. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the engine is an open-source implementation rather than a regulator-approved calculation tool, and that its conformance with filing requirements must be confirmed by the user against the applicable rules.**
